Why fleets switch

Imported filters bring three risks. A local filter removes all of them.

Currency swings, long lead times and counterfeits all cost you vehicle uptime. IronGuard is priced, made and checked here.

Naira pricing
Prices set in naira, so your maintenance budget isn't exposed to foreign-exchange swings.
Local, reliable supply
Made in our Ogun State factory and delivered on a schedule, so vehicles don't sit idle waiting on shipments.
No grey-market fakes
Every IronGuard filter carries a QR code your technicians can scan to confirm it came from Vitaparts.
A named account manager
One person who knows your fleet, handles your orders and brings in technical support when you need it.

Our Factory

Where every IronGuard filter is made

Vitaparts Nigeria Ltd makes IronGuard in its own factory in Ogun State. Steel coil comes in at one end; finished, tested filters leave at the other.

Location
Ogun State, NG
Established
2016
Production since
2021

How it's made

From steel coil to finished filter

Four stages on one floor, so every step is under our own control.

  1. Stage 1Stamping

    Steel strip feeds from the coil into a multi-station press that forms the cans and base plates.

  2. Stage 2Assembly

    The filter element, valves and base plate are fitted and each can is sealed on automated lines.

  3. Stage 3Transfer and pressing

    Conveyors carry every filter between stations and through the guarded press cell.

  4. Stage 4Finishing

    Cans pass along the overhead finishing line before packing and QR labelling.

How to check a filter

Check it's genuine before it goes on the vehicle

A counterfeit filter can let grit reach the engine. Every genuine IronGuard filter can be checked in seconds.

  1. Step 1
    Find the QR codeIt's printed on the IronGuard box and on the filter.
  2. Step 2
    Scan it with a phone cameraA genuine filter opens this page, showing "This filter is genuine and verified".
  3. Step 3
    No code, or a different page?Don't fit it. Tell us where you bought it or message us on WhatsApp and we'll follow up.
